title: Stable selected-channel preview and v5 library
notes: Removes the persistent/background live window and releases full-screen playback whenever its screen closes, reducing decoder contention, crashes and remote lag. The guide preview now stays on the channel explicitly selected with OK while focus can move freely through the EPG. Includes the complete v5 hierarchical classification for the bundled 25,398-channel playlist. Existing personal favourites, settings, add-ons and logins are preserved.
